features.feature: Consultant profile, services, office pin, policy
Firm with team members and calendars
Weekly hours, several sessions a day
No double booking (exclusion constraint, locks, 10-minute hold)
Admin: categories, commission, policies, verification, bookings, reports
Privacy, consent, access logs, signed links

scenarios.title: Find a Consultant and the public APIs
scenarios.description: Guests can search; everything private is refused.

scenarios.title: Consultant onboarding and setup
scenarios.description: Profile, team, hours, services, certificates, publish.

scenarios.title: Booking: individual, team, group, any member, no double booking
scenarios.description: Customer books; the database refuses a second booking of the same time.

scenarios.title: Consultant actions: pay at visit, receipts, completion code, calendar
scenarios.description: The consultant's side of a booking.

scenarios.title: Admin and operator
scenarios.description: Categories, commission, verification, bookings, reports, permissions.

scenarios.title: Navigation and apps
scenarios.description: Tile Board entries and the mobile apps.

cases.title: Find a Consultant opens for a guest; 'coming soon' while the module is off
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). (or off, for the second check)
cases.steps:
1. Open /consult as a guest
2. Switch the rule off and open /consult again
cases.expected: On: the search box, category list, 'Near me' and consultant cards (name, modes, fee, next free time) show without sideways scroll on a phone. Off: a 'Coming soon' note, no error page.

cases.title: Public consultant search answers with results (or 'not available' while off)
cases.steps:
1. GET /api/consult/search
2. GET /api/consult/search?category=general-physician&mode=VIDEO&maxFee=500
cases.expected: 200 with {results: [...], radiusKm}; each result has name, slug, modes, fee range, rating, next free time. Off: 404 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE.

cases.title: A guest cannot book, see bookings, use the consultant or admin APIs
cases.steps:
1. POST /api/consult/bookings with an empty body
2. GET /api/consult/bookings
3. GET and POST /api/consult/firm/<any id>
4. GET /api/admin/consult
cases.expected: Every call answers 401 before reading the request; nothing is created.

cases.title: A private file link without a session or with a bad signature is refused
cases.steps: 1. GET /api/consult/files/booking/<id>?exp=…&sig=bad without a session
cases.expected: 401 (no session); with a session and a wrong or expired signature: 403. No file bytes.

cases.title: A consultant sets up a booking profile, team member, hours and a service, and publishes
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). An approved shop with a map pin.
cases.steps:
1. POST /api/consult/firm/<shop> {action:create}
2. profile (name, headline, notice 0)
3. hours for the owner member
4. service (free, 15 min, in person)
5. publish
cases.expected: Profile LIVE; GET ?view=setup shows no remaining problems; the consultant appears in /api/consult/search by name.

cases.title: A doctor cannot publish without the council registration certificate
cases.steps:
1. Put the member in category General Physician
2. Publish
cases.expected: 409 naming the missing registration certificate; after uploading a PDF the profile publishes with verification PENDING.

cases.title: A customer books a free appointment at a free time; it is confirmed at once
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). A live consultant (TC-CON-005).
cases.steps:
1. GET /api/consult/availability?serviceId=…
2. POST /api/consult/bookings with the first free start, visitor name, consent
cases.expected: 201; status CONFIRMED, booking number CBYYMM-NNNNNN; the time no longer appears in availability; times shown in IST.

cases.title: Two customers cannot take the same time, even at the same moment
cases.steps: 1. Customer 1 and customer 2 POST /api/consult/bookings for the same member and start at once
cases.expected: Exactly one 201; the other 409 'That time was just taken'.

cases.title: Another customer cannot see or act on someone's booking
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). A booking of customer 1.
cases.steps:
1. As customer 2: GET /api/consult/bookings/<id>
2. POST {action:cancel}
cases.expected: 404 for both; the booking is unchanged.

cases.title: The customer cancels before the free-cancellation time; the time is free again
cases.steps:
1. POST /api/consult/bookings/<id> {action:cancel}
2. GET availability
cases.expected: CANCELLED by CUSTOMER; full refund of anything paid online; the time is offered again; both sides notified.

cases.title: The customer moves a booking within the policy; the limit is enforced
cases.steps:
1. reschedule to another free time
2. repeat beyond max reschedules
cases.expected: First moves succeed (reschedule count +1, reminders moved); beyond the limit 409 with the policy reason.

cases.title: Pay at visit: the consultant records the payment and a receipt is issued
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). A fixed-fee booking with 'pay at the visit'.
cases.steps:
1. As the consultant POST {action:paid, method:UPI}
2. Open the receipt
cases.expected: Payment status PAID, paid at visit = fee, receipt number GKC/<FY>/NNNNNN; receipt shows the firm, customer, service and amounts (tax invoice when the firm is GST-registered).

cases.title: Completion needs the customer's 4-digit code; a wrong code is refused
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). A confirmed in-person booking starting within 15 minutes.
cases.steps:
1. complete with a wrong code
2. customer reads the code on the booking
3. complete with that code
cases.expected: Wrong code: 422 with tries left; right code: COMPLETED; settlement lines written; the customer can rate it.

cases.title: The consultant's calendar and dashboard show the booking
cases.steps:
1. GET /api/consult/firm/<shop>?view=calendar&from=<today>&to=<+7>
2. ?view=dashboard
cases.expected: The booking is listed with visitor, service, status and its member; dashboard has upcoming count, earnings and utilisation.

cases.title: Online payment holds the time and confirms the booking on success (sandbox on the test site)
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). Test site with the sandbox gateway.
cases.steps:
1. Book a fixed-fee service paying online
2. On the sandbox page press Pay (success)
cases.expected: While paying the booking is PENDING_PAYMENT with a 10-minute hold; after success CONFIRMED, PAID, receipt issued; the customer lands on the booking page.

cases.title: A failed online payment frees the time
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). Sandbox gateway.
cases.steps:
1. Book paying online
2. Press Fail on the sandbox page
cases.expected: Booking EXPIRED with payment FAILED; the time is offered again; the customer is told.

cases.title: Admin sees every booking, reports, categories and policy templates
cases.steps:
1. GET /api/admin/consult?view=bookings
2. ?view=report
3. ?view=categories
4. ?view=templates
cases.expected: 200 each: bookings with filters; report totals, by category, area and day; 28 seeded categories with commission and required registration; Standard/Flexible/Strict templates.

cases.title: Customers and shop owners are refused the consultant admin API
cases.steps: 1. As a customer and as a shop owner: GET and POST /api/admin/consult
cases.expected: 403 for both.

cases.title: Admin adds and edits a category with its commission and required registration
cases.steps:
1. Admin → Shops → Consultants → Categories → Add
2. Set commission 5% and registration RCI
cases.expected: Saved; listed with 5% and RCI; a booking in that category uses 5% commission.

cases.title: Each role has its entry on the Tile Board
cases.steps:
1. Customer: Shops → Consultants, Orders → Appointments
2. Shop owner: Orders → Appointments
3. Admin and operator: Shops → Consultants
4. Operator-limited: My shops → Consultant setup
cases.expected: Each entry opens its page; every menu still fits the one-screen rule.

cases.title: Near me: results are nearest first with distance and directions
cases.steps: 1. GET /api/consult/search?lat=<customer>&lng=<…>&radiusKm=25
cases.expected: Results ordered by distance; each has distance text and a Google Maps directions link; a far location returns none.

cases.title: A group session takes several people up to its capacity
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). A GROUP service with capacity 3.
cases.steps:
1. Book 2 places
2. Another customer books 1
3. A third tries 1
cases.expected: First two succeed (fee × people); the third gets 409; availability shows places left.

cases.title: Team appointment books two consultants together; 'any available' picks a free member
cases.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). A firm with two members.
cases.steps:
1. Book the TEAM service
2. Book 'any available' at a time one member is busy
cases.expected: Team booking holds both members; 'any available' assigns the free member.

cases.title: Booking notices go to both sides at once; reminders are scheduled 24 h and 1 h before
cases.steps:
1. Book
2. Read the customer's and owner's notifications
cases.expected: Both get an 'Appointments' notification immediately; two reminder notices are scheduled (scheduled_notices CONSULT_REMINDER).

cases.title: Report a problem opens a help-desk ticket linked to the consultant
cases.steps: 1. POST {action:dispute, reason}
cases.expected: A ticket in category 'An appointment booking', priority High, linked to the firm; a second dispute is refused.

cases.title: The apps show the module; /consult opens in the Android app
cases.steps:
1. In the GoKesari app open Shops → Consultants and book
2. Tap a /consult link outside the app (Android 1.9.0)
cases.expected: Booking works inside the app; a booking push opens its page; the link opens the app (Android 1.9.0+).

e2e.title: Book a consultant, pay at the visit, complete with the code
e2e.journey: Consultant publishes → customer finds and books (pay at visit) → consultant records payment → completes with the customer's code → customer rates
e2e.expected: Booking CONFIRMED → PAID (receipt) → COMPLETED; commission line in the next payout; rating on the profile.

e2e.title: Book online, cancel, refund
e2e.journey: Customer books paying online (sandbox) → cancels before the free-cancellation time
e2e.expected: Hold → CONFIRMED/PAID → CANCELLED with a full refund in progress; the time is free again.
e2e.preconditions: Rule consultBooking switched on (Admin → Settings). Sandbox gateway.
